method: Species that trigger the fish-ID protected-species warning (07 § thresholds, 06 § fish ID). This file only decides when the advisor adds a release reminder; it states no rule. Current rules come from the rules table (advisor_rules), which the reply links to. must_release follows CDFW's Summary of Recreational Groundfish Fishing Regulations (the list of rockfishes that may not be taken or possessed in California, page updated 2026-06-23), checked on checked_at; canary is a sub-bag species there, not a no-retention one.
